title: Mastering Lens Subluxation: From Etiology to Surgical Management
summary: Lens subluxation (ectopia lentis) represents a complex zonular pathology requiring precise diagnostic evaluation and tailored surgical intervention. This guide synthesizes clinical classification, management algorithms, and emergency protocols for the modern ophthalmologist.

sections.title: Definition & Epidemiology
sections.content: Ectopia lentis is defined as the displacement of the crystalline lens from its physiological position due to zonular dehiscence. Subluxation is partial displacement; Luxation (dislocation) is total displacement. Prevalence is highly variable, often secondary to ocular trauma (most common) or systemic connective tissue disorders (Marfan syndrome, Homocystinuria).

sections.title: Clinical Features & Signs
content: Iridodonesis (tremulous iris)
Phacodonesis (lens movement)
Monocular diplopia
Refractive shift (induced astigmatism/myopia)
Secondary glaucoma (pupillary block or phacolytic)
Vitreous prolapse into anterior chamber

sections.title: Management Algorithm
content: Step 1: Assess zonular integrity (Slit lamp/Gonioscopy).
Step 2: Manage intraocular pressure (IOP).
Step 3: Determine need for surgery (Visual acuity, glaucoma, uveitis).
Step 4: Surgical planning (Capsular tension rings (CTR), Ahmed segment, pars plana vitrectomy).
Step 5: Post-op rehabilitation.

sections.title: Red Flags: Immediate Referral
content: Acute Angle Closure Glaucoma from pupillary block.
Phacolytic glaucoma (lens proteins in trabecular meshwork).
Evidence of open globe injury if traumatic.
Progressive worsening of vision in children (Amblyopia risk).

sections.title: Surgical Nuances
content: Use of Trypan Blue (0.06%) to visualize capsule.
Stabilize capsule early with CTR or hook system.
Avoid over-inflation of anterior chamber.
Consider pars plana lensectomy in severe displacement.
Scleral fixation of IOL (Yamane technique) if zonules are insufficient.

content.explanation: Homocystinuria = Inferior displacement; Marfan = upward (supero-temporal) displacement.

sections.title: Recent Advances
content: Femtosecond laser-assisted phacoemulsification (FLACS) helps reduce zonular stress during capsulotomy.
Development of adjustable suture-less scleral-fixated IOLs (Yamane technique).
Genetic counseling and systemic evaluation protocols have shifted toward early metabolic screening for Homocystinuria in suspected cases.
